narrative_hook_specs.description: Graffiti text '你還在嗎' appears on the underpass wall as a CanvasTexture decal. Was not present on first visit. Low opacity (0.3), cold cyan color, appears organic — like it was sprayed there.

Water drip interval shifts from regular 2-5s to irregular 8-15s with occasional double-drip (second drip follows 0.3s after first). The irregularity creates subliminal unease — the space is changing but not explaining itself.

A single set of footprints in the snow leading away from the bridge toward the distant housing blocks. Were not present on first visit. Low-poly depression geometry with cold blue-tinted snow inside the prints.

Distant housing block: one additional window is now emitting cold cyan light. On first visit 3 windows were lit; now there are 4. The fourth window is on the top floor, far right — was previously dark.

An abandoned car wreck materializes at the edge of the fog draw distance (~40 units from player). Low-poly silhouette — dark gray with barely visible hazard lights (cold amber, 0x00bcd4 glow). Was not present on previous visit.
Fog density permanently increases by 40% (fogDensityBase × 1.4). Visibility drops from ~45 units to ~27 units. The highway is being consumed by fog. Reverts only if infection drops below 60.

One streetlight (the second from the left) has burned out. The pool of cold cyan light it previously cast is now darkness. A faint wisp of smoke/steam rises from the dead fixture (small particle effect). The street is dimmer.

Emergency light on the distant building facade starts blinking with irregular intervals (1-3s random). Casts a brief cold amber flash across the street each cycle. Was completely off on previous visits.

Fluorescent ceiling light flickers off for exactly 1 frame (~16ms), then returns to normal. Only on third+ visit. Player may question if they imagined it. The flicker coincides with a 0.1s audio dropout in the drone.

Wind drone gains a dissonant second oscillator layer — a 73Hz sine wave LFO modulating the main drone gain at 0.13Hz. Creates a slow beating/pulsing that makes the cold feel deeper. Only triggers after collecting fragments.

revisit_trigger_specs.effect: Viewer counter permanently increments from 1 to 2. System message displays: 'Viewer #2 connected.' No further explanation. The counter never goes back down. Player knows someone else is now watching.
revisit_trigger_specs.implementation: app.js:applyGameResponse() — after scene_trigger processing, check visitedScenes.size >= 3 and !viewerBumped flag; if true, set viewerCount = 2, show system dialog with message, set viewerBumped = true

revisit_trigger_specs.effect: Water drips in rain_underpass now have frozen quality: interval doubles to 5-10s, each drip followed 0.2s later by faint ice-crack burst (80Hz filtered noise, 50ms duration, 3% volume). The rain is freezing over.
revisit_trigger_specs.implementation: audio.js:createRainDrips() — accept visitedScenes parameter, check cross-scene condition, modify interval range to [5000,10000], add secondary short noise burst after each drip

revisit_trigger_specs.effect: Fog density permanently increases by 50% (fogDensityBase × 1.5) and fog color shifts slightly toward green-cyan (0x003a4a → 0x003a3a). The highway is literally sick. Reverts if infection drops below 55.
revisit_trigger_specs.implementation: background.js:switchScene() — in fog_highway case, if infection >55 and visited, multiply fogDensityBase by 1.5, adjust fog.color toward green-mixed cyan

revisit_trigger_specs.effect: 20% chance on each subsequent scene transition of a 1-frame white flash (full-screen white div, opacity 0.3, removed after 50ms). The world is glitching. A glass-shatter-like short noise burst accompanies it (white noise 30ms, 5% volume).
revisit_trigger_specs.implementation: app.js:applyGameResponse() — on scene_trigger, if fragments >=5, roll Math.random() < 0.2, create flash overlay div with setTimeout removal at 50ms. background.js: separately trigger noise burst on flash.

revisit_trigger_specs.effect: Snow particle count increases 50% (current: ~500 particles → 750), particle velocity doubles, visibility drops. An overturned trash can (low-poly cylinder + box) appears near the second streetlight. The blizzard is intensifying each time the player returns.
revisit_trigger_specs.implementation: frontend/js/scenes/blizzard_street.js:createScene_blizzard_street() — check visitCount >=3 and infection >40; multiply particle count by 1.5, speed by 2.0; add trash can mesh group at predefined coordinates near streetlight

fragments.trigger_condition: infection_level >= 20, random timer 45-120s after scene entry
infection_level >= 30, random timer 60-150s after previous fragment
triggered on any scene revisit (visitCount >= 2), appears within 30s of entry

fragments.text: they are watching through the screen

fragments.trigger_condition: infection_level >= 65, appears immediately on reaching threshold
infection_level >= 90, appears immediately, only once per session

glitched_text_spec.implementation_function: corruptText(text, infectionLevel) → string — applies 1-3 random Unicode combining marks (U+0300-U+036F) to ASCII letters at linear rate from 5% (infection=70) to 30% (infection=95). CJK characters and punctuation preserved unmodified. Called from typewriterEffect() before character-by-character rendering.
